name: Dread Wight — "Each of those creatures gains …" goes to the creatures picked, for good
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). "At end of combat, put a paralyzation counter on each creature blocking or blocked by this creature and tap those creatures. Each of those creatures doesn't untap … for as long as it has a paralyzation counter on it. Each of those creatures gains \"{4}: Remove a paralyzation counter from this creature.\"" produced nothing: the group antecedent ran on through "and tap those creatures". Who fought whom is over once the ability matters, so "each creature blocking or blocked by" is read as a pick of any number of creatures (_resolveTheyPronoun). Two things found on the way: the unfired card must not grant the ability (quoted grants on a permanent's trigger line are skipped in the static parse), and the untap sentence's "for as long as it has a paralyzation counter" is that sentence's own duration, not a condition on the grant. Bears and Ogre picked: both have the ability with no counter on them; Hill Giant and Dread Wight do not.
